reviewed: single-word headwords unknown to Italian frequency data
_finding: Checking every one-word lowercase headword against wordfreq's Italian corpus flagged 68 entries. Most were legitimate rare or technical words the corpus simply lacks (antonimo, piastrellatore, gramscismo, eucalipteto). Twenty-five were not Italian: misspellings, a Greek/English spelling, a truncated word, and two Spanish words that had leaked in. Seven of them duplicated an entry that was already present and correctly spelled, so those are dropped; the rest are renamed with their ids preserved so learner progress survives.
